about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Our Story
about.description: Faradid Atlas connects dependable global supply with Iran's essential food market through disciplined sourcing, quality control, and distribution.
about.heroHeadline: Faradid Atlas, since 2009, has been a trusted partener in the supply of essential food commodities.
about.heroImageAlt: Faradid Atlas food import and distribution operations
about.foodSecurityPractical: Food security through sourcing, import, and distribution
about.storyP1: Faradid Atlas was established in 2009 to strengthen food security across Iran, UAE, and Oman. We source and import rice, legumes, nuts, seeds, spices, and sugar from India and Pakistan, applying ISO 22000 food safety standards throughout our supply chain to deliver consistent quality to wholesalers, foodservice operators, and organizations.
about.storyP2: Our recognized rice brands — 21, Mizban, Hayat, and Golbanou — reach wholesalers, foodservice partners, retailers, and organizations through offices in Tehran, Isfahan, Dubai, and Oman, supported by operational warehousing including Shahrekord for efficient regional distribution.
about.missionText: Our mission is to remove unnecessary intermediaries, protect supply chain continuity, and create lasting value for customers and the wider community.
about.blockquote: Healthy, quality food should be accessible. That belief guides every sourcing and distribution decision we make.
about.whatWeOfferDescription: Practical food supply services designed for continuity, fair pricing, and dependable quality.
about.valuesIntro: A compact set of standards guides how the team selects partners, protects quality, and builds long-term commercial trust.
about.workWithUsDescription: Whether you are a buyer, supplier, or future teammate, we value practical thinking, professional ethics, and long-term trust.
about.sourcing_description: Direct relationships with first-tier suppliers in key food-producing markets, especially India and Pakistan.
about.qc_description: Every product is selected against international quality and hygiene standards before entering the supply chain.
